criteria.notes: Condition and trigger are inverted (condition 'door is opened', trigger 'closed after 60 seconds or less'); meaning recoverable but awkward.

duplicates.rationale: Different badge states; shared message is intended by source.

findings.actual: Relation EN1 to US2 is proposed, but no criterion states that a fourth-item record made offline is retained and uploaded.
findings.expected: Offline behaviour: what happens to the fourth-item recording and warning when the kiosk is offline, since events are queued.
findings.impact: Offline over-limit records could be dropped unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add a question or a proposed criterion on offline fourth-item recording.
findings.why: R6 and R4 interact; the source does not state it, so this is a candidate rather than a confirmed gap.

findings.actual: Criteria for US2 and US5 are written as testable although day boundary, item detection and volunteer identity are unknown.
findings.expected: Open blocking questions Q1, Q2 and Q5 should block readiness of US2 and US5.
findings.impact: Stories cannot be built or verified until answered.
findings.recommendation: Mark US2 and US5 not ready until Q1, Q2 and Q5 are resolved.
findings.why: Criteria hold only under assumptions not in the source.

findings.actual: AC12 merges unknown and deactivated badges; AC10 has inverted condition and trigger.
findings.expected: Symmetric criteria for offline rejection paths.
findings.recommendation: Split AC12 into two criteria and reword AC10 as when the door is closed within 60 seconds, no alert sounds.
findings.why: Reduces clarity and traceability of each partition.
